title: Smart Data Models - Open Energy Ontology - GridComponent
description: A grid component is an energy transformation unit that is a discrete part of a supply grid serving a specific purpose. A grid component is defined by having a grid component role (oeo:OEO_00020006 'grid component', Open Energy Ontology v2.14.0, definition verbatim). Modelled generically: the specific OEO subclass (grid node, switchyard, transformer, AC-line, HVDC-line, vehicle charging station, ...) is carried in oeoClass.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'GridComponent'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

name.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/name'. The name of this item.

alternateName.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/alternateName'. An alternative name for this item.

description.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/description'. A description of this item.

location.description: GeoProperty. Geojson reference to the item. Point, LineString or Polygon (RFC 7946). Not an OEO term: OEO has no direct geometry on artificial objects, so the NGSI-LD core location is used.

oeoClass.description: Relationship. The specific OEO class of this entity (rdf:type), as the class IRI. OEO v2.14.0 declares 19 classes in the 'grid component' hierarchy (this class and all its subclasses), all allowed here: AC-line = oeo:OEO_00000047; HVDC-line = oeo:OEO_00000126; bidirectional vehicle charging station = oeo:OEO_00320065; compressed-air energy storage unit = oeo:OEO_00020249; electricity grid component = oeo:OEO_00000144; energy storage unit = oeo:OEO_00000399; gas grid component = oeo:OEO_00020007; grid component = oeo:OEO_00020006; grid component link = oeo:OEO_00000255; grid node = oeo:OEO_00000296; heating grid component = oeo:OEO_00020008; overhead power line = oeo:OEO_00440000; power line = oeo:OEO_00000253; power line for vehicles = oeo:OEO_00420004; submarine power line = oeo:OEO_00440001; switchyard = oeo:OEO_00020009; transformer = oeo:OEO_00000420; underground power line = oeo:OEO_00440002; vehicle charging station = oeo:OEO_00320040.

partOf.description: Relationship. The SupplyGrid this component is part of (BFO 'part of'; OEO axiom: grid component part of some supply grid).

isConnectedTo.description: Relationship. Neighbouring grid nodes in the same supply grid (oeo:OEO_00000526 'is connected to', domain and range grid node). Only meaningful when oeoClass is grid node or one of its specialisations; for links use hasPart / connects patterns of the grid model in use.

ratedVoltage.description: Relationship. Rated voltage class: the intended operating voltage level (oeo:OEO_00410068 subclasses): extra high rated voltage = oeo:OEO_00410073; high rated voltage = oeo:OEO_00410072; low rated voltage = oeo:OEO_00410070; medium rated voltage = oeo:OEO_00410071.

powerRating.description: Property. Power rating: the maximum power the object can convert (charge/discharge power for storage). Units:'MW'. OEO models this as a quantity value class (oeo:OEO_00230001) linked through 'has quantity value'; flattened here to a plain number in the stated unit.

gridOperator.description: Property. Name(s) of the grid operator(s) (TSO/DSO) responsible for this object. Not an OEO term: OEO declares 'power plant operator' but no grid operator class.

commissioningEnd.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Date'. Commissioning end: the date on which commissioning finished, i.e. the start of commercial operation (oeo:OEO_00020421, a temporal instant in OEO, flattened to an ISO 8601 date).

decommissioningStart.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Date'. Decommissioning start: the date on which decommissioning began (oeo:OEO_00020417, flattened to an ISO 8601 date).

operationalStatus.description: Property. Operational status of the object. Not an OEO term (OEO has no operating-status vocabulary for artificial objects); the values follow the Open Power System Data / BNetzA power plant list (operating, reserve, seasonal_conservation, shutdown_temporary, shutdown, special_case), plus planned and underConstruction.

eicCode.description: Property. ENTSO-E Energy Identification Code (EIC) of this object. Not an OEO term; added because it is the identifier used for generation units, plants and grid nodes in European market data.
